aboutBody:
I’m a software engineer with 3+ years of enterprise application development experience, building backend and web systems with Java/Spring Boot and C#/.NET. My work spans REST APIs, database optimization, integration testing, and software delivery.

Outside my enterprise work, I build and operate cloud and containerized systems using AWS, GCP, Terraform, Docker, and K3s. My homelab is where I explore observability, connected devices, and the practical details of running applications.

I also implement AI features in my personal projects, integrating Gemini and DeepSeek APIs into web applications and monitoring tools. My receipt tracker uses AI to extract receipt details, answer spending questions, and generate summaries. My homelab dashboard uses AI to interpret system health and network anomalies, while my infrastructure monitoring agent combines live telemetry with LLM-based analysis and requires human approval before infrastructure actions execute.

I focus on practical AI integration: connecting models to relevant application data, providing fallback paths, and keeping people able to review and correct the results.
